# Website Quality Audit: Screenshot Description

## Overall Layout
The screenshot displays a single-page layout with a hero section featuring a full-width background image and overlaid text content. The design follows a classic vertical scroll structure with a prominent header section and body text below.

## Background Image
The background features a high-quality, atmospheric photograph of a wedding reception setup. The image shows:
- A dark, elegant table setting with lit candles (both tall taper candles and shorter votives)
- An elaborate floral arrangement with roses and other blooms in cream, pink, and white tones
- Glassware including wine glasses and what appears to be a champagne flute
- The image has a warm, dim lighting that creates an intimate, romantic atmosphere
- The background is slightly blurred, creating depth and focusing attention on the foreground text

## Color Scheme
- **Background**: Dark, warm tones (browns, blacks) with the photographic background
- **Text overlay**: White and gold/cream colored text for contrast against the dark background
- **Accent colors**: The gold/cream color is used for emphasis on key words and headings

## Typography
- **Main heading**: "Свадебный ужин" (Wedding Dinner) - appears in a large, elegant serif font, with "Свадебный" in white and "ужин" in gold/cream
- **Subheading**: "День, который вы будете вспоминать вечно" (A day you will remember forever) - in a slightly smaller serif font, with "вспоминать" highlighted in gold/cream
- **Body text**: Paragraphs in a clean, readable sans-serif font in white
- **Breadcrumb navigation**: Smaller text in the top-left corner

## Spacing and Layout
- Generous padding/margin around text elements to ensure readability against the busy background
- Clear hierarchy with heading sizes decreasing from main title to subheading to body text
- The text is centered horizontally on the page
- Good line spacing in the body text for readability
- The breadcrumb navigation is positioned in the top-left corner with appropriate spacing from edges

## Content Structure
- Breadcrumb navigation: "Главная / Форматы / Свадьба" (Home / Formats / Wedding)
- Main heading: "Свадебный ужин"
- Subheading: "День, который вы будете вспоминать вечно"
- Two substantial paragraphs of descriptive text about wedding catering services
- The text describes the wedding dinner experience, emphasizing emotional connections and sensory details

## Visual Issues/Concerns
- The dark background with white text creates good contrast, but may be challenging for users with visual impairments
- The busy background image with text overlay requires careful typography choices to maintain readability
- No apparent accessibility features visible (alt text, ARIA labels, etc.)
- The gold/cream highlighting in the text is subtle but effective for drawing attention to key phrases
- No visible navigation elements beyond the breadcrumb, suggesting this might be an inner page

## Overall Impression
The design effectively creates an elegant, romantic atmosphere appropriate for a wedding catering service. The typography choices and spacing work well against the background image, though the dark background with white text may present readability challenges for some users. The layout is clean and focused on conveying the emotional appeal of the wedding dinner experience.
